fields.name: rpm
fields.label: RPM
fields.description: Engine speed.

fields.name: speed
fields.label: Speed
fields.description: Road speed from the ECU.

fields.name: battery
fields.label: Battery
fields.description: System voltage. 13.8–14.4 V running; below 13 = charging fault.

fields.name: coolant_temp
fields.label: Coolant
fields.description: Coolant temperature. Normal 86–95 °C; above 105 = overheating.

fields.name: air_temp
fields.label: Intake air
fields.description: Intake air temperature.

fields.name: ext_temp
fields.label: External temp
fields.description: External temp sensor — not fitted; phantom constant. Ignore.

fields.name: fuel_temp
fields.label: Fuel
fields.description: Fuel temperature — ~70–80 °C warm, 10–15 below coolant.

fields.name: accel_way1
fields.label: Pedal track 1
fields.description: Pedal track 1: ~0.3 V idle → ~4.7 V full.

fields.name: accel_way2
fields.label: Pedal track 2
fields.description: Pedal track 2: mirror of track 1 — ~4.7 V idle → ~0.3 V full.

fields.name: accel_way3
fields.label: Pedal track 3
fields.description: Pedal track 3 — Euro 3 only; reads 0 on Euro 2.

fields.name: manifold_press
fields.label: Turbo pressure
fields.description: Turbo / boost pressure, absolute (bar). Idle ≈ ambient (~1.0); full load 2.0–2.2; overboost cut ≈ ambient + 1.42 bar.

fields.name: rpm_error
fields.label: RPM error
fields.description: Idle-speed error: target minus actual idle rpm.

fields.name: ambient_press_1
fields.label: Ambient pressure
fields.description: Atmospheric pressure — ~1.0 bar at sea level.

fields.name: ambient_press_2
fields.label: Ambient pressure 2
fields.description: Atmospheric pressure (second reading).

fields.name: balance_1
fields.label: Injector 1
fields.description: Cylinder 1 fuelling correction. ±4 healthy (owners quote ±3). Larger values are worth checking but not proof of a bad injector: owners report cars running for years at double figures.

fields.name: balance_2
fields.label: Injector 2
fields.description: Cylinder 2 fuelling correction. ±4 healthy.

fields.name: balance_3
fields.label: Injector 3
fields.description: Cylinder 3 fuelling correction. ±4 healthy.

fields.name: balance_4
fields.label: Injector 4
fields.description: Cylinder 4 fuelling correction. ±4 healthy.

fields.name: balance_5
fields.label: Injector 5
fields.description: Cylinder 5 fuelling correction. ±4 healthy.

fields.name: injection_qty
fields.label: Injection
fields.description: Injection quantity (mg/stroke). Idle ~6–10; rises with load.

fields.name: egr_modulator
fields.label: EGR
fields.description: EGR modulator duty % (1D@15, candidate).

fields.name: wastegate_modulator
fields.label: Wastegate
fields.description: Wastegate modulator duty % (1D@17, candidate).

fields.name: maf
fields.label: Air flow
fields.description: Air mass (1D u16@4) — likely a MODELLED value, not the sensor. RDL016's physical MAF (1C@4) reads 0 (air-flow-circuit fault), so this is the ECU's speed-density estimate. Candidate scale; see test T-01.

fields.name: maf_sensor
fields.label: Air flow (measured)
fields.description: Physical MAF sensor (1C@4), u16 x0.1 kg/h. Live once the 'air flow circuit' fault was cleared (2026-10-04).

fields.name: wastegate_pos
fields.label: Wastegate (0x38)
fields.description: Wastegate modulator % from native LID 0x38 (candidate, /100 per two Simon sources). Native-vs-1D@17 conflict — see T-02.

fields.name: egr_pos
fields.label: EGR (0x37)
fields.description: EGR modulator % from native LID 0x37 (candidate, /100 per two Simon sources). Native-vs-1D@15 conflict — see T-02.

fields.name: battery_direct
fields.label: Battery (direct)
fields.description: Second battery reading, 'Battery Direct' (0x10@2, candidate). The 5V sensor reference is accel_supply (1B@6), not here.

fields.name: driver_demand
fields.label: Driver demand
fields.description: Driver's demand (1D@0, candidate) — pedal request; mg/stroke (BinOwl) vs % (Simon app), drops to ~0 on overrun. See T-03.

fields.name: smoke_limit
fields.label: Smoke limit
fields.description: Smoke-map fuelling limit (1D@10, candidate).

fields.name: torque_limit
fields.label: Torque limit
fields.description: Torque-limiter fuelling ceiling (1D@12, candidate).

fields.name: egr_inlet
fields.label: EGR inlet
fields.description: EGR inlet position % from native LID 0x45 (candidate). Replaces the abandoned 1D@16 mis-map.

fields.name: coolant_sensor_v
fields.label: Coolant sensor V
fields.description: Coolant-sensor voltage (1A@2, candidate).

fields.name: intake_sensor_v
fields.label: Intake sensor V
fields.description: Intake-air-sensor voltage (1A@6, candidate).

fields.name: fuel_sensor_v
fields.label: Fuel sensor V
fields.description: Fuel-sensor voltage (1A@14, candidate).

fields.name: brake_switch_2
fields.label: Brake switch (2nd)
fields.description: Second brake pedal switch (active-high).

fields.name: brake_main
fields.label: Brake switch (main)
fields.description: Main brake pedal switch (active-low: 0 = pressed).

fields.name: cruise_master
fields.label: Cruise master switch
fields.description: Cruise control master switch on the dash (latching).

fields.name: cruise_set
fields.label: Cruise SET
fields.description: Cruise SET button on the steering wheel (momentary).

fields.name: cruise_resume
fields.label: Cruise RESUME
fields.description: Cruise RESUME button on the steering wheel (momentary).

fields.name: maf_sensor_v
fields.label: Air flow sensor voltage
fields.description: MAF sensor signal voltage (1C@6, mV). Candidate.

fields.name: accel_supply
fields.label: Pedal supply
fields.description: 5 V reference — rock-solid 5.0 V ±0.1.

fields.name: fuel_pump_relay
fields.label: Fuel pump relay
fields.description: Fuel pump relay status as commanded by the ECU (21 36 byte1 bit2). Candidate.

fields.name: accel_pedal_pct
fields.label: Accelerator pedal
fields.description: Accelerator pedal position as computed by the ECU, 0-100 % (21 1B@6 in the long form).

fields.name: fuel_rate
fields.label: Fuel rate
fields.description: Fuel flow from injection quantity × rpm (derived, candidate).

fields.name: economy
fields.label: Fuel economy
fields.description: Live consumption — only meaningful while moving (derived, candidate).

fields.name: trip_economy
fields.label: Trip economy
fields.description: Average consumption since the dashboard started (derived, candidate).

fields.name: lifetime_economy
fields.label: Lifetime economy
fields.description: Average consumption across all logged driving (derived, candidate).
